title: CI/CD Fundamentals & Jenkins
description: Learn continuous integration and delivery principles, and build automated pipelines using Jenkins.
longDescription: This module covers the principles of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), the backbone of modern DevOps. You'll learn what Jenkins is, how to set up jobs and pipelines, and how to automate the build, test, and deployment process.
whatYouLearn: Understand CI/CD principles and pipeline stages
Set up Jenkins and configure jobs
